notes.title: ✨ Part 2 coming soon!✨ Suki Suki Love
notes.notes:
[p]Thanks to the overwhelming support for [i]Suki Suki Love[/i], I’m thrilled to officially announce that [b]the second part is now in development![/b][/p][p]This time, the story leaves the school behind and steps onto the stage — into the dazzling world of fame… and the shadows that lurk behind it.
In this new installment, you’ll follow a protagonist who once had it all: talent, recognition, and countless fans…
Until it all came crashing down.[/p][p]💔 [b]Fame, downfall, and the silence behind the applause[/b] — this is a more mature and emotional chapter.
The setting may have changed, but [i]Suki Suki Love[/i] will still touch your heart with tough choices, deep bonds, and the hidden sides of the human soul.[/p][p]💫 [b]Suki Suki Love[/b] is on the way.
Thank you for staying with me on this journey. More news coming very soon. 🎶[/p][p]With love,
